name: 十字满钻滑雪手套
description:
官方款名：Cross Rhinestone Gloves
连指款滑雪手套，手背十字图案配渐变满钻，雪场上很显眼。五个颜色可选：芭比玫红（S）、芭蕾粉（S、M 各一副）、土星棕（S）、浮石黑（M）、湖水紫（M）。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 复合面料 + 100% 涤纶内衬，防风防水
- HIPORA 防水面料 + 聚氨酯涂层，防水防雪又透气，不闷汗
- 3M 新雪丽棉填充，轻薄保暖、透湿
- 抓绒内里，锁温舒适
- 指尖凯夫拉拼接，耐磨耐刮

## 设计细节
- 掌心防滑皮，握雪杖不打滑
- 手腕收紧扣，可按手腕粗细调节，防风保暖
- 雪卡口袋，刷卡方便
- 防丢扣 + 手腕挂绳，摘下手套也不怕掉
- 渐变钻饰带反光效果，光线暗时更醒目
- 虎口加宽，长时间握雪杖不勒手
descriptionEn:
Official name: Cross Rhinestone Gloves
Ski mittens with a cross on the back and gradient rhinestones all over — they really stand out on the slopes. Five colors: Barbie Rose (S), Ballet Pink (one pair each in S and M), Saturn Brown (S), Pumice Black (M) and Lake Purple (M).

## Fabric & Tech
- 3L laminated fabric with 100% polyester lining, windproof and waterproof
- HIPORA waterproof fabric with polyurethane coating — keeps out water and snow while staying breathable
- 3M Thinsulate insulation: light, warm and breathable
- Fleece lining that locks in warmth
- Kevlar fingertip panels for abrasion resistance

## Design Details
- Non-slip palm leather for a secure grip on your poles
- Adjustable wrist cinch to seal out wind and keep warmth in
- Ski pass pocket for easy scanning
- Anti-loss clip + wrist leash so you won't drop them when you take them off
- Reflective gradient rhinestones for visibility in low light
- Widened thumb crotch so long days holding poles don't pinch

name: 小熊毛绒护腕滑雪手套
nameEn: Bear Plush Mittens with Wrist Guards
description:
卡其色连指滑雪手套，手背是一只白色毛绒小熊，头顶两只毛茸茸的小耳朵，可爱又保暖。内置护腕，单板摔倒撑地时保护手腕。尺码 L。

## 设计细节
- 内置护腕，适合单板，摔倒撑地时护住手腕
- 手背白色毛绒小熊 + 立体小熊耳朵
- 掌心黑色皮革拼接，握雪杖、抓雪板更稳
- 手腕魔术贴可调松紧
- 长袖口，配收紧扣和手腕挂绳，摘下手套也不怕掉
descriptionEn:
Khaki ski mittens with a fluffy white bear on the back and two plush bear ears on top — cute and cozy. Built-in wrist guards protect your wrists when you fall on a snowboard. Size L.

## Design Details
- Built-in wrist guards — great for snowboarding, protecting your wrists when you catch a fall
- Fluffy white bear on the back with 3D plush ears
- Black leather palm panels for a better grip on poles and your board
- Adjustable hook-and-loop wrist strap
- Long gauntlet cuffs with cinch and wrist leash so you won't drop them

name: 独角兽毛绒护腕滑雪手套
nameEn: Unicorn Plush Mittens with Wrist Guards
description:
连指滑雪手套，手背是一只闭着眼睛的毛绒独角兽，头顶立体小角，侧面一圈彩虹鬃毛，戴上就是雪场最萌的那双手。内置护腕，单板摔倒撑地时保护手腕。三个颜色：紫色（M）、蓝色（M）、粉色（L）。

## 面料与科技
- HIPORA 防水透气膜，挡住雪水又不闷手
- 五指分指内胆，连指外壳更保暖，手指活动也灵活
- 3M 保暖棉

## 设计细节
- 内置立体护腕板，贴合手腕弧度，减少摔倒时手腕过度弯折
- 手背毛绒独角兽 + 立体小角 + 彩虹鬃毛
- 手腕魔术贴可调松紧
- 袖口抽绳收紧，挡风挡雪
- 防丢手腕挂绳，摘下手套也不怕掉
descriptionEn:
Ski mittens with a sleepy plush unicorn on the back — a 3D horn on top and a rainbow mane down the side. Easily the cutest hands on the slopes. Built-in wrist guards protect your wrists when you fall on a snowboard. Three colors: Purple (M), Blue (M) and Pink (L).

## Fabric & Technology
- HIPORA waterproof, breathable membrane keeps snow out without making your hands sweaty
- Five-finger inner liner — mitten warmth with finger dexterity
- 3M Thinsulate insulation

## Design Details
- Built-in contoured wrist guards that follow the curve of your wrist and help prevent overbending in a fall
- Plush unicorn on the back with a 3D horn and rainbow mane
- Adjustable hook-and-loop wrist strap
- Drawcord cuffs to seal out wind and snow
- Anti-loss wrist leash so you won't drop them
